notes.title: Update 2.0 is Now Available. View the Full Patch Notes Here
notes.content:
A brand new update is available for Remothered: Broken Porcelain. Update 2.0 adds 4k support as well as additional bug fixes. View the full notes below: 
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a certain character would hide in the wrong spot and cause a soft lock.
[*] Fixed a certain snow globe not being collectible with the moth power.
[*] It will no longer be possible for Jennifer to stop walking/talking without reason.
[*] Very rarely, Stalkers could get stuck on top of each other trying to force open a tied door. Now they can't at all.
[*] Fixed an instance where Ashmann wouldn't move in the cold room.
[*] Porcelain will no longer freeze in place after getting hit with an item.
[*] Resolved an exploit where you could bypass a large part of the Rosemary section.
[*] Fixed some issues with the Luck skill.
[*] Stalkers used to very rarely get stuck in "searching for player mode" permanently after a reload. That won't happen anymore.
[*] Jennifer will no longer become unresponsive if a certain cutscene interrupts her throwing animation.
[*] If Jennifer was hit when vaulting over an obstacle, there was a small chance she could get stuck inside it.
[*] Jennifer will now always properly snap to doors when unlocking them with a key.
[*] Fixed some minor issues with Thai in the tutorials.
[*] Fixed a bunch of typos in the English subtitles.
[*] Fixed a weird situation where Andrea could get stuck in a bathroom.
[*] Some upgraded items would lose their special properties on reload, now they'll stick around.
[*] Improved Jennifer's death animation when she's killed by fire.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.8.0.1 is Now Available for Remothered: Broken Porcelain
notes.content:
A new patch is now available for Remothered: Broken Porcelain. Fixes include:
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare instance where the user could become soft locked while going through a crawlspace.
[*] Items that disappeared on reload will now remain in your inventory.
[*] Improved physics for Jennifer's hair.
[*] Fixed a rare soft-lock when interacting with the mirror.
[*] Removed a sofa in a cinematic that Rosemary would walk through.
[*] User can no longer use the "look behind" option during conversations with Manni, which produced some weird results.
[*] Fixed some typos in various languages.
[*] Fixed a bug where the weapon reload speed was swapped when you maxed out the skills.
[*] Several different instances where lighting didn't appear after cutscenes were fixed.
[*] Players can no longer walk behind Charlie when he's barking at Jen.
[*] Stalkers will no longer get stuck in place when walking through tight corridors.
[*] Improved hot spot detection for items to make it easier to interact with them.
[*] Stalkers will not longer phase through a door that's been tied shut with a rope.
[/list]

Be sure to check the previous patch notes to see all of the updates that have been made to the game!

notes.title: Check Out All of the Fixes Now Available in Remothered: Broken Porcelain
notes.content:
Since Remothered: Broken Porcelain launched last month, the team has been hard at work making improvements to the game from gameplay changes and quality of life improvements to bug fixes and language additions. Around 200 changes have been made to the game over 15 patches.  

If you haven’t checked in for your stay at the Ashmann Inn, there is no better time than now! Check out all of the fixes below.  

[b]11/14 Patch: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes control issues in QTE sequences 
[*] Addresses timing of cutscenes 
[*] Animation polishes for certain character and boss movements 
[*] Addresses timing for musical cues 
[*] Various fixes for certain boss fights 
[*] Fixes various subtitle issues 
[/list]
[b]11/10 Patch: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed facial animations for specific sequences 
[*] Polish on stalker movement animations 
[*] Various text corrections and menu polishes 
[*] Additional minor bug fixes
[/list] 
[b]11/6 Patch:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Added button callouts for statuine menus 
[*] Fixed facial animations in several critical scenes 
[*] Made item pickups easier to interact with 
[*] Various moth power polishes and glitch fixes 
[/list]
[b]11/4 Patch:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed timing of certain cutscenes 
[*] Added polish for Locker Room Boss Fight for moth power usage 
[*] Fixed glitches related to boss character animations 
[/list]
[b]10/30 Patch: [/b]
[list]
[*] Andrea healing behavior is fixed. 
[*] Various visual glitches fixed 
[*] Fixes for characters getting stuck in corners. 
[*] Fixed order of cinematics in Cutscenes menu. 
[/list]
[b]10/28 Patch:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Polishes for boss AI behavior 
[*] Bug fixes on VO and speaking facial animations 
[*] Fixed scaling of videos for widescreen displays 
[*] Fixed skills UI 
[/list]
[b]10/27 Patch:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Moth power is overhauled with improved usability 
[*] Players will be able to view the "Brain" menu while hiding 
[*] Character animations corrected when moving along stairs and other raised areas in the environment 
[*] Improved dodging mechanics to prevent getting stuck in the environment 
[*] Video Settings are properly saved 
[*] Collision detection improvements 
[*] Fixed trajectory of objects being thrown by certain player characters 
[*] AI logic for navigating through environment improved 
[*] Fixed several instances where dialogue would not play correctly 
[*] Boss battle refinements 
[*] Improved item placement throughout levels 
[*] Animation fixes for stalker kills and other camera clipping issues 
[/list]
[b]10/23 Patch [/b]
[list]
[*] Electrical cable will no longer spark when it’s not there anymore. 
[*] Can no longer place door items (rope, cable, etc) on locked doors. 
[*] Reduced the amount of times one of Jennifer’s lines plays. 
[*] Enemies should be better about throwing you out of a corner if you get stuck. 
[*] Fixed a few more instances where the player could lose control of Jennifer. 
[*] Fixed a really bizarre instance where players couldn’t upgrade skills if their save slots were full. 
[*] Jen will now stay crouching after using the moth power, if you were crouched beforehand. 
[*] Improved music playing consistently when Stalkers spot you. 
[/list]
[b]10/21 Patch [/b]
[list]
[*] Video setting save properly. 
[*] Fixed some lighting issues in a specific cinematic. 
[*] Resolved a number of different edge cases where the user could lose control of Jennifer. 
[*] Crafting tutorial should only show up once now. 
[*] Power ups now properly carry over game to game. 
[*] Now users will not be able to interact with things while a cinematic is playing. 
[*] Jennifer will no longer spawn in the middle of an empty world in certain scenarios. 
[*] Improved behavior of the moth power to be more consistent. 
[*] The “Don’t use a save point” achievement can now be collected if you use a hypnosis spot for healing. 
[*] Moths can no longer be spawned outside of walls. 
[*] Sound effects (screams, gunshots, etc) will no longer play during loading screens. 
[*] Added back in certain sound effects that somehow went missing. 
[*] Andrea’s voicelines will now no longer play when using the dodge skill on Porcelain. 
[*] There was a rare case where the player could lose control of Jennifer after she interacted with a mirror, this has been resolved. 
[*] There were some strange cases where Porcelain wouldn’t spawn in the underground bunker, those bugs have been squashed.
[*] Elisa promises she won’t forget how to open doors ever again. 
[*] Jennifer can now lose the basketball game. 
[/list]
[b]10/19 Patch [/b]
[list]
[*] Key Rebinding has been temporarily disabled. 
[*] Stalkers should have a harder time seeing you while crouching. 
[*] Enemies will no longer get stuck trying to climb over rails. 
[*] Sometimes enemies would try to peek through doors causing them to get stuck. 
[*] Stalkers will no longer politely wait for you to finish peeking through a door before trying to stab you to death. 
[*] Crafting power ups will now be visible on a game reload. 
[*] Andrea will no longer glide in place after being stunned by a moth. 
[*] Fixed an instance of saving and reloading where you wouldn’t have a key you need. 
[*] Lindsay is now better at basketball, dreams one day of being star forward. 
[/list]
[b]10/17 Patch: 
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some instances where characters appeared during cinematics who weren’t supposed to be there. 
[*] Texture Quality is now always properly reflected in settings. 
[*] Spamming the cover button will not make inputs be dropped. 
[*] Fixed instances where Ashmann sometimes would not aggro on Jennifer correctly. 
[*] Removed the ability to vault over the railing towards the end of the game. 
[*] Jennifer will no longer become invincible if hit by multiple enemies on the same frame. 
[*] You can no longer spam vault over and over. 
[*] Added some sound effects. 
[*] Some items could just disappear if you clicked the wrong button, they won’t do that any more. 
[*] Game used to hang when trying to load corrupted data, but now it will not display the corrupted save at all. 
[/list]
[b]10/16 Patch: [/b] 
[list]
[*] Made it so that when a Stalker is actively pursuing you, most interactables like hiding spots, locked doors, drawers, etc cannot be interacted with. You can still pick up items and open doors, of course, but this should prevent you from accidentally opening a drawer and then being stabbed to death. 
[*] Changed Ashmann’s behavior after the confrontation in his office so that he can no longer be backstabbed. This was causing confusion among players and the objective should be clearer now. 
[*] Fixed more instances where the player could lose control of Jennifer. 
[*] Enemies will no longer pull you out of a loophole and immediately throw you in a loop. 
[*] Sometimes Elisa forgot how to open a door. She’ll remember now. 
[*] Reduced colliders on the car in the garage to make shooting easier. 
[*] Moved a really inconveniently placed chair in Ashmanns office to somewhere more out of the way. 
[*] Some miscellaneous bug fixes. 
[/list]
[b]10/15 Patch:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese is now available. 
[*] The moth power will now bounce off of obstacles instead of becoming stuck. We will continue to fine-tune this behavior. 
[*] Added a 1-second buffer to the start of cut scenes where they are unskippable, to prevent cinematics being skipped by accident. 
[*] Several situations that resulted in the player no longer being able to control Jennifer or prevented progress have been resolved. 
[*] Andrea will now remain knocked out after saving and reloading after acquiring her key. 
[*] Fixed some cases where an enemy would become stuck on objects. 
[*] Jennifer no longer has the ability to attack after she has been killed. 
[/list]
[b]10/14 Patch: [/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese language is now available 
[*] Stalkers now attack with less frequency to give more chances to escape them 
[*] Main character movement and collisions were fine-tuned to make exploration and escapes smoother 
[*] Defeating Andrea now requires less attacks 
[*] Stalkers now grab players less frequently 
[*] In various instances, some items were lost when reloading a saved game or checkpoint, among those Key Items and Moth Keys 
[*] Young Ashmann could appear alongside Old Ashmann in specific scenes 
[*] Sometimes throwing items would have no effect on enemies 
[*] General bug fixes for graphical glitches and camera clippings for specific instances 
[*] No icons were shown in certain tutorials 
[/list]
[b]10/13 Patch:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Andrea will no longer become unresponsive after dying and respawning during a specific event. 
[*] Fixed a softlock that involved Ashmann killing Jennifer before opening the door to the kitchen. 
[*] Fixed some Untranslated text in the tutorial menu. 
[*] Identified and resolved a bug where sometimes settings were not properly saved. 
[*] Solved some audio inconsistencies in a few sequences. 
[*] Character skins no longer light up in a strange way when close to fire. 
[*] Made it so that subtitles no longer remain on screen when a sequence with subtitles is skipped. 
[*] “Skip” button prompt for end credits appears “B” as opposed “A” through the rest of the game, fixed. 
[*] Changed interaction boxes for furniture close to doors to not overlap the interactions. 
[/list]

[*] Stalkers will no longer politely wait for you to finish peeking through a door before trying to stab you to death.
[*] Crafting power ups will now be visible on a game reload.
[*] Andrea will no longer glide in place after being stunned by a moth.
[*] Fixed an instance of saving and reloading where you wouldn't have a key you need.
[*] Lindsay is now better at basketball, dreams one day of being star forward.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4.1 is now available as of 10/17!
notes.content:
Another day, another patch to address some more user feedback! Patch 1.0.4.1 includes:

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some instances where characters appeared during cinematics who weren't supposed to be there.
[*] Texture Quality is now always properly reflected in settings.
[*] Spamming the cover button will not make inputs be dropped.
[*] Ashmann sometimes would not aggro on Jennifer correctly.
[*] Removed the ability to vault over the railing towards the end of the game.
[*] Fixed an instance where [spoiler] Gloria would not shoot Porcelain [/spoiler].
[*] Jennifer will no longer become invincible if hit by multiple enemies on the same frame.
[*] You can no longer spam vault over and over.
[*] Added some sound effects.
[*] Some items could just disappear if you clicked the wrong button, they won't do that any more.
[*] Game used to hang when trying to load corrupted data, but now it will not display the corrupted save at all.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is Now Available!
notes.content:
A new patch is now available for download that addresses additional player feedback.

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Made it so that when a Stalker is actively pursuing you, most interactables like hiding spots, locked doors, drawers, etc cannot be interacted with. You can still pick up items and open doors, of course, but this should prevent you from accidentally opening a drawer and then being stabbed to death.
[*] Changed Ashmann's behavior [spoiler] after the confrontation in his office so that he can no longer be backstabbed. [/spoiler]This was causing confusion among players and the objective should be clearer now.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed more instances where the player could lose control of Jennifer.
[*] Enemies will no longer pull you out of a loophole and immediately throw you in a loop.
[*] Sometimes Elisa forgot how to open a door. She'll remember now.
[*] Reduced colliders on the car in the garage to make shooting easier.
[*] Moved a really inconveniently placed chair in Ashmanns office to somewhere more out of the way.
[*] Some miscellaneous bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: A New Patch is Available as of 10/15
notes.content:
In our continued effort to squash bugs and improve the overall player experience, we have deployed a brand new patch that addresses some of the user feedback we have received. Updates in this patch include:

[b]General changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese is now available.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The moth power will now bounce off of obstacles instead of becoming stuck. We will continue to fine-tune this behavior.
[*] Added a 1-second buffer to the start of cut scenes where they are unskippable, to prevent cinematics being skipped by accident. 
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Several situations that resulted in the player no longer being able to control Jennifer or prevented progress have been resolved.
[*] Andrea will now remain knocked out after saving and reloading after acquiring her key.
[*] Fixed some cases where an enemy would become stuck on objects.
[*] Jennifer no longer has the ability to attack after she has been killed. 
[/list]

Again, thank you for your patience as we continue to make fixes, and continue to give us feedback! Our team is working diligently to address the feedback through patches.

notes.title: Another Patch is Now Available as of 10/14
notes.content:
Today, we deployed a new patch that addresses some additional player feedback. We are continuing to monitor the Steam Community for newly reported bugs and are working to fix as much as possible. 

The newly available patch includes the following fixes: 

[b]General changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese language is now available
[/list]
[b]Gameplay fine-tuning[/b]
[list]
[*] Stalkers now attack with less frequency to give more chances to escape them
[*] Main character movement and collisions were fine-tuned to make exploration and escapes smoother
[*] Defeating Andrea now requires fewer attacks
[*] Stalkers now grabs players less frequently
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] In various instances some items were lost when reloading a saved game or checkpoint, among those Key Items and Moth Keys
[*] Young Ashmann could appear alongside Old Ashmann in specific scenes
[*] Sometimes throwing items would have no effect on enemies
[*] General bug fixes for graphical glitches and camera clippings for specific instances
[*] No icons were shown in certain tutorials
[/list]

Please continue to pass along any feedback and we will keep you updated with new fixes as they become available.

notes.title: A New Update is Available for Remothered: Broken Porcelain as of 10/13
notes.content:
Let me start by thanking everyone for the feedback that we are receiving in the form of bug reports. We are monitoring all of our social channels and passing that feedback along to the team to try to fix as many issues as possible. 

Today, we deployed an update that fixes some common issues users have been experiencing. This list does not cover all of the user feedback we have received, but we wanted to get a fix live for issues that we could resolve now. We are continuing to work on addressing the additional feedback we have received. 

The new patch includes fixes for the following:

[list]
[*] Andrea will no longer become unresponsive after dying and respawning during a specific event.
[*] Fixed a softlock that involved Ashmann killing Jennifer before opening the door to the kitchen.
[*] Fixed some Untranslated text in the tutorial menu.
[*] Identified and resolved a bug where sometimes settings were not properly saved.
[*] Solved some audio inconsistencies in a few sequences.
[*] Character skins no longer light up in a strange way when close to fire.
[*] Made it so that subtitles no longer remain on screen when a sequence with subtitles is skipped.
[*] “Skip” button prompt for end credits appears “B” as opposed “A” through the rest of the game, fixed.
[*] Changed interaction boxes for furniture close to doors to not overlap the interactions.
[/list]

Again, thank you so much for the feedback. If you are experiencing other issues, add them to this post as a comment and we will add it to our list to investigate.
